summary.en: Run the project's tests (pytest, node --test, npm test) and get passed/failed/skipped counts, each failing test with its message, and the full log as a file.
summary.ru: Запустить тесты проекта (pytest, node --test, npm test) и получить числа прошедших, упавших и пропущенных, каждый упавший тест с сообщением и полный лог файлом.

required.name: files.read
required.reason: to find which test tool the project uses

required.name: processes.run
required.reason: to run the tests in the workspace sandbox

required.name: artifacts
required.reason: to keep the full test log as a file

tools.name: run
tools.summary: Run tests and return a structured result: status (passed, failed, error, timeout), counts, failing tests with messages, the command and a link to the full log.

runner.description: Defaults to auto: detected from the project.

target.description: A test file, folder or pytest node id (path::name); empty runs everything.
